description: Committee recommends reviewing all City Council advisory committees.
Review will examine mandates, relevance, and funding processes.
Aims to improve clarity, consistency, and effectiveness.

chips.text: Council wants detailed budget submissions from each advisory committee for 2027.
Committees feel files arrive too late for meaningful input.
Grassroots organizations benefit from committee's sponsorship program.
Committees want to work directly with staff, but current rules prevent it.
Unclear if Council supports early advisory committee work.
Administration will compile feedback and present recommendations to Council.

description: Advisory Committee proposes 2027 work plan and budget.
Includes funding for committee's sponsorship program.

chips.text: Committee debated creating its own social media presence.
Follows new city process for advisory committee budget submissions.
Questioned ownership and future of Living in Harmony awards project.
Work plan includes supporting anti-racism events and scholarships.
